reviews.text: Girls are fantastic with my dog my dog was nervous at first going the groomers now she’s not a bother and she always comes out looking gorgeous thanks to Rachel she is amazing with the dogs very professional and sweet

Extremely disappointing experience. I have been a regular client at this business since 2024, so I’m particularly disappointed by how this situation was handled.

I had an appointment booked today and travelled to the shop specifically for it, only to arrive and find the business closed with absolutely no direct communication to me.

What I find especially unacceptable is that I received a text from the business the day before my appointment asking me to confirm that I would be attending. I confirmed my appointment, only to then arrive today and discover that the shop had apparently already been closed for the previous two days. If you knew the business had been closed for two days, why was I contacted the day before to confirm my appointment rather than being told that it was cancelled?

I completely understand that unexpected technical issues can happen, but the communication was extremely poor. I was apparently expected to find out through an Instagram post. If a customer has an appointment booked, they should be contacted directly when that appointment is cancelled. I should not have to check Instagram to find out whether an appointment I have already confirmed is still going ahead.

What makes this even more frustrating is that on previous occasions, when an appointment had to be cancelled, I was contacted directly by email. So I had every reason to expect the same level of communication this time.

I needed this appointment today as I am going away, meaning rearranging it is no longer useful to me. I wasted my time travelling to the shop and was left standing outside with no warning or explanation.

After being a regular and loyal client since 2024, I genuinely expected much better. Unfortunately, this experience has completely changed my view of the business. You have lost a loyal customer, and I will not be booking with you again.
Tidy Tails and Katelyn in particular, were amazing with my dog Tia. I couldn’t recommend them more.
Groomers are amazing and the doggies love going ❤️❤️
Helpful patience well experienced and pleasant

My dog is infamous for HATING having his nails done. So much so that he’s had to go the vet’s and have a drug so that they can try and do it. Nine times out of ten they haven’t been able to. However every single time I bring Archie to be groomed at Tidy Tails they get it done no problem!
I would recommend them to any other dog parent! Also I really like how the set up of the groomers and how nice they are.

I didn’t like the way my dog was groomed. They just shaved her and gave her a square-shaped face. We have a Maltese, and after such a haircut, she was extremely stressed, cold, and anxious. I could have shaved her myself. She had koltuns, but instead of carefully dealing with them, they shaved her down as short as possible. In the second photo, you can see how my dog was groomed in Portugal, and this is exactly how I asked them to groom her this time.
I don’t recommend this place.

Best groomer I've ever had! Millie is just gorgeous and my other dog Suki had her nails done and was very nervous, but the dog groomer was so professional. Thank you so much, we'll will definitely be back!
Excellent groomers! Not only do they do a great job but they are very kind and you can tell they love animals. It’s the only place we will bring our dog!
Thanks so much to Caitlin and Andrea for doing a great job on Stella I’m so happy with her would highly recommend the staff so friendly booked back in already
Super professional, excellent service. My dog can be a little nervous sometimes but he was super chill in such good hands. And now he smells amazing! I will definitely be back. A+
Always delighted my my dog hair cut from here. She is so professional and I know my dog is in safe hands with her!

I'm so happy to find this hidden gem. I brought my dog Slinky on Tuesday for a full groom, and he came out looking and smelling great. I was extremely nervous about dropping him off because obviously he's my baby, and it was my first time bringing him here, but I have to say the girls were amazing. My last groomers never really asked for my input or had a consultation with me before the groom, so it was a really nice touch when the girls talked me through everything beforehand and asked me what length etc I'd like Slinky's hair. Really pleasant experience and a lovely atmosphere. I'll be back.
